description: Search hotels in Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Goa. For Dubai and Abu Dhabi, returns Fostay's hand-curated edit first (8 flagship stays with editorial verdicts), then catalog matches (~2,000 bookable hotels). For Goa, returns the best-reviewed hotels and resorts (hostels and homestays only when searched by name), optionally narrowed to one area. For Dubai and Abu Dhabi, pass checkin and checkout to get live all-in prices for the shortlist in the same call (from_total_all_in, from_per_night, refundable, rooms_available), a fostay_url that opens each hotel on those exact dates, and any major event (F1, GITEX, National Day, NYE...) those dates fall in. Without dates, use get_live_rates for prices. For the Abu Dhabi Grand Prix call event_stays instead: it ranks hotels by distance to the circuit. Results include a fostay_url where a human can view photos, live rates and book.

area.description: Goa only: narrow to one area — candolim-calangute-baga (Candolim, Calangute & Baga); anjuna-vagator (Anjuna, Vagator & Assagao); morjim-mandrem-arambol (Morjim, Mandrem, Arambol & Siolim); panaji-old-goa (Panaji & Old Goa); south-goa-beaches (Colva, Benaulim, Varca & Cavelossim); palolem-agonda (Palolem & Agonda)

checkin.description: Dubai/Abu Dhabi only: check-in date YYYY-MM-DD. With checkout, the results carry live prices for the stay.

checkout.description: Dubai/Abu Dhabi only: check-out date YYYY-MM-DD (pass with checkin).

currency.description: Currency to quote in (AED, INR, EUR, AUD, SGD, NZD). Defaults to the hotel's home currency: INR for Goa, AED for Dubai and Abu Dhabi. The price quoted is the price charged.

min_rating.description: Minimum guest rating on a 10 scale, e.g. 8
